Spray Dried Lemon Juice Powder for Food and Beverage Manufacturers

Spray dried lemon juice powder gives formulators a sharp, clean lemon taste in a dry, easy-to-dose form. Beverage brands, snack seasoners, confectioners and bakeries use it where liquid juice would be hard to store or would add unwanted water. Tradenest Naturals manufactures and exports this powder from Surat, India, for food companies, importers and private label brands. Buyers choose a dried lemon powder exporter for consistency, and that is where we focus. Each batch is made to the same specification: 80-100 mesh, moisture ≤ 5.0% and a shelf life of 24 months. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, so your team can check the details before ordering.

Manufacturing and Quality Approach

Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. Lemon juice is spray dried with a permitted food-grade carrier (maltodextrin), which keeps the powder free-flowing and stable. Spray drying removes water quickly, so the bright, tangy citrus character stays in the finished powder. We keep batch records for traceability and check moisture, flow and appearance before packing. The result is a uniform powder that disperses easily in dry mixes and dissolves well in water. If your market needs independent results, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Key Applications in the Food and Beverage Industry

Our wholesale dried lemon powder suits a wide range of commercial products. Beverage companies use it in instant drink premixes, lemonade powders and iced tea blends. Snack makers dust it over potato chips, popcorn and extruded snacks for a tangy finish. Confectionery brands add it to fruit gummies, hard candies and fillings. Bakeries use it in lemon cakes, icings and glaze mixes. Because the powder is dry, it adds lemon flavor without adding moisture to dry mix recipes.

Why Partner with Tradenest Naturals?

Choosing a spray dried lemon powder manufacturer affects the consistency of your finished product. We offer fair pricing, planned supply and packaging built around your needs. Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and IEC registered exporter, and our team supports you with export documentation. We work with growing brands as well as large processors. Our MOQ is 5 Kg, samples are available on request, and OEM and private label packing is available. Contact our sales team to request a sample or a quote.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried lemon juice powder?

The MOQ is 5 Kg. This lets you run trials before moving to larger volumes.

What quality documents are available?

A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We pack the powder in moisture-resistant export bags and drums. Stored sealed in a cool, dry place, shelf life is 24 months.

What are the typical specifications?

The powder is spray dried to 80-100 mesh, with moisture ≤ 5.0%. A food-grade carrier (maltodextrin) is used to keep it free-flowing.

How do I request a sample or quote?

Send us a message through the website inquiry form or by email. Our export team will reply with pricing and sample details.
